articles.title: Saudi Arabia is tokenizing its multi-trillion dollar economy to protect its wealth from global shocks
articles.snippet: The chairman of droppRWA has secured $12.5 billion in mandates to tokenized real estate and his plans are to go beyond properties to bring trillions of dollars onchain.

articles.title: Bitcoin tumbles below $79,000 as rising bond yields, inflation worries rattle markets
articles.snippet: Stocks, gold and crypto slid on Friday while crude oil topped $100 and traders repriced Fed expectations for rate hikes.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: BNB is only gainer as index drops 2%
articles.snippet: BNB (BNB) rose 0.4% while Bitcoin (BTC) fell 1.3% from Thursday.

articles.title: OKX, Korea Investment and Securities said to be in talks for 40% of Coinone
articles.snippet: OKX's planned move into the South Korean market would echo that of Binance, which completed its acquisition of Seoul-based Gopax last year.

articles.title: Hana Bank to acquire $670 million stake in Upbit operator Dunamu
articles.snippet: The South Korean bank announced plans for a won-pegged stablecoin, blockchain remittances and tokenized securities.
